many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

    fcol,frow=floor
    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]

def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cs=comps(g)
    floor=None
    for c in cs:
        if len({y for y,_ in c[1]})==1 and len(c[1])==W: floor=c
    fcol=floor[0]; frow=floor[1][0][0]
    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for x in range(W): res[frow][x]=fcol
    objs=[c for c in cs if c is not floor]
    changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False
        for col,cells in objs:
            cur=list(cells)
            while True:
                can=all(0<=y+1<H and res[y+1][x]==0 for y,x in cur)
                if not can: break
                cur=[(y+1,x) for y,x in cur]; changed=True
            for y,x in cur: res[y][x]=col
    return res

def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cs=comps(g)
    floor=None
    for c in cs:
        if len({y for y,_ in c[1]})==1 and len(c[1])==W: floor=c

    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]

        colv=[g[y][x] for y in range(frow+1,H) if g[y][x]!=0]
        for i,v in enumerate(reversed(colv)): res[H-1-i][x]=v
    return res

    for c in cs:

    objs=[(c[0],list(c[1])) for c in cs if c is not floor]
    # repeat: always move the lowest-settling object (largest max row) further down
    while True:
        best=None
        for i,(col,cells) in enumerate(objs):
            mx=max(y for y,_ in cells)
            if best is None or mx>best[0]: best=(mx,i)
        if best is None: break
        _,i=best
        col,cells=objs[i]
        cur=list(cells)

                cur=nxt
            else: break
        objs[i]=(col,cur)
        # clear old cells
        for y,x in [(y_,x_) for y_,x_ in []]: pass
        # update res via cells below this object? easier: rebuild res from scratch each pass

    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]

    # simpler: collect all placements, resolve conflicts bottom-up: later objects win; order objs bottom-up by placement

def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0])
    cs=comps(g)
    floor=None
    for c in cs:
        if len({y for y,_ in c[1]})==1 and len(c[1])==W: floor=c
    fcol=floor[0]; frow=floor[1][0][0]
    d=1 if frow>H//2 else -1
    out=[[fcol]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for x in range(W):
        vals=[g[y][x] for y in range(H) if y!=frow and g[y][x]!=0]
        base=(H-1-d*(len(vals))) if d==1 else 0
        # slide toward floor: if floor at bottom, place bottom vals at rows H-1.. ; if at top, at rows 0..
        if d==1:
            for i,v in enumerate(reversed(vals)): out[H-1-i][x]=v
        else:
            for i,v in enumerate(vals): out[i][x]=v
    return out
